shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A woman in a navy cardigan sits in the shelf-side window seat and explains the rules, a woman in a emerald blouse sits in the shelf-side aisle seat, and a man in a charcoal hoodie sits in the doorway-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The woman in a navy cardigan asks a question as a man in a mustard sweater enters, sits in the doorway-side window seat, and answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a charcoal hoodie asks about the turn, and the woman in a navy cardigan replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the shelving-unit end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the doorway, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
